image_tool.description: Exact name of the native image tool that rendered the mockups, or NONE if no image could be generated.

baseline_problems.description: Concrete problems seen in the baseline screenshot, each tied to a visible element.

direction.description: The visual approach in one or two sentences.

preserved.description: MUST PRESERVE items this variant keeps, explicitly.

image_path.description: Absolute path of the rendered mockup, or empty string if rendering failed.
